description:
Whether the company can issue right now, and if not, why.

Call it before a company's first document, and when issuing
fails for a reason that is not the document's: ready is false
with missing naming the cause (certificate, certificate_expired,
certificate_unreadable, address), each fixed in the Stackin
dashboard, not here. Also the certificate's expiry, the tax
regime (CRT), the state and the default série per document type.
Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

name: get_company_readiness

outputSchema.description: Whether the company can issue right now, and if not, why.

default_series.description: The série used per document type when none is sent.

missing.description: Why not: certificate, certificate_expired, certificate_unreadable, address. Empty when ready.

tax_regime.description: CRT: 1 Simples, 2 Simples excesso, 3 normal, 4 MEI.
